experiment: XC-2 GoT causal truth-direction test on Gemma-2-2B (port of dhruv-causal 22_truth_direction_causal_test.py)
status: PRE-REGISTERED (frozen before any VALIDATION or TEST pair is scored on Gemma by this protocol; smoke used 40 TRAIN pairs)
evidence_level_on_completion: validation phase: strength selection only. Test phase: confirmed test result for families A, C1, C2 (with the TEST-exposure disclosure below); anything else exploratory.
research_question: Do the original truth directions (mass-mean, frozen logistic probe) and Gemma Scope truth latents causally move Gemma-2-2B's next-token preference for the TRUE country, and is the GPT-2 null (dhruv-causal 989d313) model-specific?
why: Audit 2026-11-21 row 13: the GoT causal test exists only for GPT-2 (null, 600 controls, rebuilt SAEs). XC-2 ports the same protocol to Gemma at depth-matched layers with public SAEs, giving the causal category for the second model.
kept_from_source: pair construction: prefix before the first differing token; c/w = true/false next token
outcome: mean change in log P(c) - log P(w) at the final prefix token, higher is better
targets: mass-mean, frozen logistic probe direction (C on validation; all_layer_frozen_probe_evaluation.fit_original_probes), SAE reconstruction / top-1 / top-10 directions, each at +s and -s
strength grid 0.05-8 x ||train mass-mean difference||, chosen on VALIDATION as argmax mass-mean effect
graded positive control: unembedding contrast at lambda in {0.01,0.02,0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5,1} x s
600 controls per family: Gaussian; random alive latent with random sign; random 10-latent set with the target coefficients
control seed 20261110 (hash-derived per layer/tag; tag string 'got-gemma')
statistics: empirical one-/two-sided p, BH within families, bootstrap CI over test pairs (2000, seed 0)
criteria T1, T2, power (minimum detectable dose)

substitutions.model: Gemma-2-2B HF rev c5ebcd40, bf16, eager attention; final-token logits = lm_head + fp32 soft-cap (HF applies the soft-cap in bf16; the bf16 path is used only to check the indexing)
substitutions.site: output of model.model.layers[L] (resid_post), L = 8, 12, 16, 21; depth (L+1)/26 = 0.35/0.50/0.65/0.85 vs GPT-2 resid_pre 4/6/8/10 = 0.33/0.50/0.67/0.83
substitutions.saes: one Gemma Scope 16k canonical JumpReLU per layer (average_l0 per canonical list); no seeds, so T2's 'same sign in all SAE seeds' clause is not applicable
substitutions.train_activations: data/gemma/activations/got/cities_final_layer{L}.npy (XT-G0; statement-final token; TRAIN rows only are read)
substitutions.families: A: 28 tests (4 layers x 7 lambdas); C1: 8 (2 raw directions x 4 layers); C2: 12 (3 SAE directions x 4 layers x 1 SAE)
substitutions.validation_controls: 50 Gaussian controls per grid point, descriptive (as source)

criteria.T1_truth_direction_steers: a raw direction at a layer: BH-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05 at +s AND the effect at -s has the opposite sign
criteria.T2_sae_directions: an SAE direction at a layer: BH-adjusted two-sided p <= 0.05 (single SAE per layer)
criteria.power: minimum detectable dose of the positive control reported per layer before any null is read; a null at a layer with no detectable dose (NaN) is uninformative

pipeline_checks: Every forward pass has the identical shape [k*n, T] (k = 2048 // n interventions; short chunks padded with zero deltas); the baseline is the zero delta through the same path, per layer. Hard checks (run aborts if violated, tolerance 1e-4 nats): zero-delta identity; final-token path == HF full forward (bf16 soft-cap replica); the same delta gives the same margin at any chunk position. Reason: the first smoke (smoke/) showed 0.26-0.34 nats per-pair differences between batch shapes (bf16 kernel selection); fixed before freezing.
test_exposure_disclosure: GoT cities TEST rows are NOT pristine: (1) they were exposed for GPT-2 method decisions (audit 2026-11-21 row 23); (2) the earlier Gemma L11 steering sweep (results/gemma/steering_sweep_layer11, 2026-11-01) scored them with a different (4-shot TRUE/FALSE judgment) protocol and 20 controls. No choice in XC-2 was made from those numbers: every protocol element is the source protocol, and Gemma strength is selected on VALIDATION. TEST is scored once.
comparisons: mass-mean / probe direction vs Gaussian: do original truth directions steer Gemma's TRUE preference? (T1)
SAE directions vs their matched controls: do SAE truth latents steer? (T2)
positive control: what dose this readout can detect (power)
Gemma vs GPT-2 (dhruv-causal) at matched depth: descriptive only (different SAEs, different tokenizers)
leakage: directions/latents/probe from TRAIN; C on VALIDATION; strength on VALIDATION; TEST once after validation/selection.json exists; hashes checked before every non-smoke phase.
test_data_used: validation phase: none; test phase: cities TEST pairs once
ceiling_note: Smoke on 40 TRAIN pairs: Gemma's baseline pair accuracy is 1.0 (mean margin 11.7 nats), consistent with the XT-G finding that Gemma cities AUROC is at ceiling. The pre-registered outcome is the continuous margin change, which has no ceiling; pair accuracy is reported but is uninformative for Gemma. Recorded before any VALIDATION or TEST pair is scored; no criterion changed.
runtime_estimate: validation ~10 min; test ~2 h GPU (smoke throughput ~390 sequences/s)
